question: Which Nationalist Democratic Progressive Party (NDPP) leader was sworn in as the fifth Chief Minister of Nagaland in March 2023?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Neiphiu Rio**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Neiphiu Rio** was sworn in as the fifth Chief Minister of Nagaland in March 2023.
 
• He is a leader of the **Nationalist Democratic Progressive Party (NDPP)**.
 
• Neiphiu Rio has previously served as the Chief Minister of Nagaland and is a prominent political figure in the state.
 
• His leadership is expected to bring continued focus on the development and progress of Nagaland.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Nationalist Democratic Progressive Party (NDPP)** is a regional political party in Nagaland.
 
• Neiphiu Rio has played a significant role in Nagaland's politics and has been a driving force behind various developmental initiatives in the state.
 
• His leadership tenure has seen efforts towards peace and stability in the region, alongside economic and infrastructural development.
